newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish bourse live trade starts at 1035 GMT on Thursday. [CORRECTED 14:35 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Polish bourse live trade starts at 1035 GMT on Thursday. [CORRECTED 14:35 GMT]

text.p: Warsaw Stock Exchange continuous trade on Thursday started at 1135 local time rather than the normal 1100, the bourse said in a statement without giving reasons for the delay.
(Corrects day in headline and text from Friday).
The continuous trading system, which lasts two hours, currently lists 15 companies and is separate from the bourse's main single-price auction system in which the same firms and 65 others are traded.
